edges.reason: Owned constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
msg.sender is the value assigned to owner during deployment.
transferOwnership writes the proposed address into newOwner.
The _newOwner parameter flows into the newOwner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on the stored owner value.
Caller identity is compared against owner to authorize transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with the staged newOwner.
newOwner value is promoted into owner during acceptOwnership.
require(msg.sender == newOwner) authorizes the ownership acceptance.
Constructor initializes _totalSupply to the fixed supply value.
Constructor credits the whole supply to a hardcoded address in balances.
Constructor sets the token symbol string.
Constructor sets the token name string.
Constructor sets the decimals value.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
The tokenOwner parameter is used as the key into balances.
transfer mutates sender and recipient entries of balances.
transfer delegates the sender decrement to safeSub.
transfer delegates the recipient increment to safeAdd.
transfer depends on the guarded subtraction for the sender balance.
transfer depends on the guarded addition for the recipient balance.
transfer keys balances with msg.sender for the source of funds.
The tokens parameter determines the transferred amount.
The to parameter is used as the balances write key.
approve writes the granted amount into the allowed mapping.
The tokens parameter becomes the allowance value.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key in approve.
The spender parameter is the secondary allowance key.
transferFrom mutates the from and to entries of balances.
transferFrom decrements the caller allowance in allowed.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient increment.
transferFrom relies on guarded subtraction for balance and allowance.
transferFrom relies on guarded addition for the recipient balance.
The from parameter is the balance debit key.
The to parameter is the balance credit key.
The tokens parameter controls the allowance and balance movements.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
The tokenOwner parameter is the outer allowance key.
The spender parameter is the inner allowance key.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before calling out.
approveAndCall performs an external call to receiveApproval on a caller-supplied address.
The spender contract can re-enter SuomenMarkka during receiveApproval before state settles.
The spender parameter is the allowance key and the callback target.
The tokens parameter is written as the allowance value.
The data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
transferAnyERC20Token executes an external call on an arbitrary token address.
The arbitrary token contract can call back into SuomenMarkka during the external transfer.
The tokenAddress parameter selects the external callee contract.
The tokens parameter is the amount passed to the external transfer.
onlyOwner restricts the foreign-token rescue to the stored owner.
Caller identity is checked against owner before the external transfer executes.
safeAdd performs the guarded addition represented by the overflow check.
safeSub performs the guarded subtraction represented by the underflow check.
safeMul performs guarded multiplication that shares the overflow-check semantics.
safeDiv guards its denominator before performing division.
